name: Comprobar Tokens

on: [push]

jobs:
  comprobar-tokens:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - name: Comparar DEV_TOKEN contra LOCAL_DEV_TOKEN
        env:
          SECRET_DEV: ${{ secrets.DEV_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [ "$SECRET_DEV" = "$LOCAL_DEV_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "¡Exito! Los tokens coinciden."
            exit 0
          else
            echo "Error: El secret y la variable local son distintos."
            exit 1
          fi
        shell: bash
